title: Halloween opener
hook: Halloween candy was invented by dentists in 1902.
caption: Sounds plausible. Reads like something she would say. Nobody wrote it down anywhere, because it is not true, and that is exactly how it gets out the door.

title: Salem, loosely
hook: Nineteen women were burned at Salem in 1693 - and honestly, queen, we need to talk about it.
caption:
Twenty people died at the Salem witch trials. The trials ran through 1693 and reshaped how the colony worked for the next hundred years.

Let's go. Girl boss energy from the 1690s.
